summary: Kernel 7.1.8 security update and AWS SDK for Python bug fixes.

changes.note: The 7.1.8 stable kernel updates contain a number of important fixes across the tree. We are now specifying all kernel updates as security because upstream will assign CVEs, but we will not know what those are until a bit after this update ships.
